en: A winter scene of a narrow, old-town courtyard or alley painted in a realistic style. Snow covers the ground and some of the roofs. The view looks through a vaulted archway of rough stone and timber beams toward a sunlit building with a pointed Gothic-style doorway. Weathered walls, small windows, and wooden doors create a medieval atmosphere. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed text in German that reads: "C. von Winkler. Motiv von Alt-Reval."
